normalization: Semantic Thumb instructions omit literal displacements, pointer values and call targets; local branch destinations are checked separately.

printers.name: parameterized-printer
printers.evidence: The text argument is stored as the first word of the printer template passed to the core printer.

printers.name: parameterized-printer-spacing
printers.evidence: The text argument is stored as the first word of the printer template; caller spacing supplies the template fields.

printers.name: battle-printer
printers.evidence: The text argument is saved in the printer template; the selected battle window supplies its geometry and font.

printers.name: field-item-message
printers.evidence: The text argument reaches the item-message formatter through its stack text parameter, which expands it before the parameterized printer.

printers.name: party-item-message
printers.evidence: The text argument reaches the item-message formatter through its stack text parameter, which expands it before the parameterized printer.

printers.name: template-printer
printers.evidence: The printer copies the text template into its queue and dispatches the selected font renderer.

table_printers.name: list-template-initializer
table_printers.evidence: The initializer copies the list template into task storage. The list renderer loads each item text from field zero of eight-byte records; template fields supply the items pointer, total count and window.
